summary: Discussion-sourced signals: Anthropic/Claude Code multi-projects and AGENTS.md adoption; OpenHands agent-scoping & new model support; multiple security reports about agent-enabled breaches and MCP vulnerabilities; operator reports on repo-based agent attacks and multi-agent error-reproduction workflows; infra patterns around memory-as-substrate and sandboxing guidance. | Vendor-only snapshot: mix of mainstream product releases (Anthropic, Mistral, AWS, Vercel), operator-focused how‑tos (Google ADK, JetBrains, AWS/S3 vectors), and infra primitives (Cloudflare auth, Modal sandboxes, Vercel MCP). Missing social/discussion signals for operational field reports. | GitHub OSS snapshot: mix of official agent/platform releases and many repo-only agent/tool launches. High-priority vendor releases (Cloudflare, OpenAI, Google, Qwen, Mem0) and gaps in social/operator reports. | Package-layer snapshot: mix of vendor-backed agent tooling (OpenAI Codex/ChatGPT), VS Code agent extensions (deepsweep, Axme), and several infra primitives (eval, sandbox, offload). No social/user-field reports in this shard — many items are single-package evidence and need corroboration.
